component: Symbol candidates, deduplication and final OCR

actual_input.capture_note: Exact available recorded inputs. File/DOM/library objects may be represented as opaque metadata; raw byte/array references remain authoritative.

expected_input: Provider token candidates, spatial overlap information and symbol alternatives.

actual_output.capture_note: Return values are retained unchanged. captureError for JSON.stringify(undefined) is a recorder serialization limitation, not an application exception. Use observed resulting state for void methods.

expected_output_contract: Merged tokens with retained provenance/alternatives. Preserve literal printed values and symbolic quantities. Do not turn L or m into a numerical length or mass.
expected_diagram: 60° is printed apex-angle evidence. Vertices and rays require source measurement. No numerical refractive index is printed. An assumed index must not be described as measured from this diagram.
finding: Compare the literal source labels with the retained tokens below. A wrong alternative is not necessarily the selected output. 60° is printed apex-angle evidence. Vertices and rays require source measurement. No numerical refractive index is printed. An assumed index must not be described as measured from this diagram.
change_or_loss: OCR alternatives → selected token set. PageIR text blocks are filled from these tokens inside the evidence pipeline.
